name: m01-1.8-understand-linux
title: Lab 1.8, part 1: get the lab, Ollama from zero (version, pull, list, show), the port it listens on, one raw API call, and explore.py (the model file, next-token prediction, the app re-sending history)
before: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ollama || (setsid nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done

steps.label: One API call
steps.type: curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/chat -d '{"model": "gemma3:1b", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Why is the sky blue? One sentence."}], "stream": false}' | python3 -m json.tool

steps.label: Next token
steps.type: python3 explore.py next "The capital of France is"
